text: I think my mental health is better than it's been since my kids were born. I didn't realise how depressed I was until I started to come out of it. I used to feel like I was failing at everything and that I'd never have a moment for myself. The experience gave me a feeling of being okay, of being enough, and that has slowly changed how I feel day to day. I appreciate my kids so much more now, instead of just seeing them as another job. We have pancake Saturdays and we go to the park, and I actually enjoy it instead of counting the minutes. I'm also kinder to myself, which has made me less irritable. I still get tired, of course, but I don't feel that heavy hopelessness anymore. I feel a lot of love for my kids and for my mum, who helps us so much, and I tell them more often.
Ich bin ausgeglichener und habe weniger Angstzustände. Ich fühle mich insgesamt stabiler.

I'm more content with my life and less anxious about where I'm supposed to be by now. I appreciate what I have: good friends, a job I mostly like, my health, my little flat. I'm more open to the idea that life doesn't have to follow a set script, and that's been a big relief. I feel happier and less pressured.
Ich grüble weniger und bin dadurch weniger niedergeschlagen. Ich kann meine Gedanken besser beobachten, ohne mich in ihnen zu verlieren.

My mental health has been tested a lot in the last two years, and I think it held up better than it would have without the experience. I've had some low periods, especially after the separation, but I haven't fallen into a deep depression, which has happened to me before and which happened to my dad. I think the main reason is that I'm more open now, with my emotions and with other people. I let my friends and family support me, and I talk about how I feel instead of bottling it up. I also appreciate the good things in my life more: my kids, who I see every other weekend, my brother, the hills around my hometown where I go walking. I've rediscovered a lot of old friendships since moving back. I'm still finding my way, but I feel hopeful about the future, and I think I'm becoming a more open and honest person.
I've become a lot more indifferent. Things that used to make me happy or upset just don't register as much. It's not depression, I don't feel sad, I just feel kind of neutral about most things.

Ich bin selbstbewusster geworden und fühle mich weniger ausgeliefert. Ich habe gemerkt, dass ich ein Recht darauf habe, gehört zu werden. Das hat meine Stimmung sehr verbessert, und ich habe weniger depressive Phasen. Ich verstehe auch besser, warum ich mich immer so klein gemacht habe: In meiner Familie durfte ich als Kind nie widersprechen.
Pretty much the same, maybe slightly happier

The experience was the beginning of healing after my brother's death. For four years I'd been numb and depressed, though I didn't really admit it. I was functioning, but I wasn't living. I had nightmares and I couldn't look at photos of him. After the experience I was able to grieve, and slowly the numbness lifted. I can feel joy again, and love. I can look at his photos and smile. My depression has improved a lot, and I don't have nightmares anymore. I've also become much closer to my parents, because we talk about him together now. I feel a deep gratitude for the time I had with him, and for being alive. I appreciate my life in a way I didn't before, maybe because I know how fragile it is. Volunteering on the crisis line gives me a sense of purpose. I feel like I'm honouring him by helping others.
Etwas zuversichtlicher und ruhiger, insgesamt aber kein großer Unterschied.

I'm more emotionally honest and less avoidant, which has improved my mental health. I used to have a lot of hidden anxiety that I numbed with work. Now that I face things, I feel more grounded and less on edge. I understand myself better and I'm working on things in therapy. My relationship is also better, which makes me happier.
Less anxious and a bit more confident

Meine psychische Gesundheit hat sich durch die Erfahrung deutlich verbessert. Ich hatte jahrelang eine generalisierte Angststörung, die mich sehr eingeschränkt hat. Ich war ständig angespannt, konnte schlecht schlafen und hatte oft Magenprobleme. Seit der Erfahrung bin ich viel ruhiger geworden. Die Angst ist nicht ganz weg, aber sie ist viel leiser. Ich schlafe besser und habe kaum noch Magenprobleme. Vor allem aber habe ich das Gefühl, dass ich das Leben jetzt genießen kann. Ich bemerke die schönen Dinge, die Sonne, die Vögel, ein Lächeln von einem Fremden. Ich bin dankbar für mein Leben, und das war ich vorher nie. Meine Freunde sagen, dass ich viel entspannter geworden bin und dass es mehr Spaß macht, Zeit mit mir zu verbringen.
I'm less exhausted and more balanced. I take better care of my energy.

I've been more patient and positive throughout my health problems, and I haven't fallen into depression, which I was worried about. I appreciate my body and my health more now, and I'm grateful for every bit of progress. I also feel more open to change and less attached to how things used to be.
Ich bin selbstbewusster und weniger ängstlich in Beziehungen. Das tut mir gut.

The experience has transformed my mental health. I've had anxiety all my life, and it shaped everything: my choices, my relationships, my career. I always played it safe, and I was always unhappy. Since the experience, my anxiety has decreased dramatically. I'm not saying it's gone, but it doesn't run my life anymore. I've done things I never thought I'd do: I quit my job in accounting and retrained as a landscape gardener, and I moved to Scotland, where I'd always dreamed of living. I'm so much happier now. I feel a deep appreciation for life and for the natural world, which I spend most of my days in now. I'm also more open to new experiences and new people. I've made friends here who are very different from my old friends, and I love that. I feel like I'm finally living my own life.
I felt really good for maybe two or three weeks after, very open and happy. Then it slowly faded and now I'm about where I was.

Ich fühle mich weniger einsam und habe weniger depressive Phasen. Meine Freundschaften sind tiefer geworden, weil ich mich mehr öffne. Mir ist klarer geworden, wie viel mir meine Freunde und meine Schwester bedeuten, und ich nehme ihre Unterstützung inzwischen auch an. Insgesamt geht es mir psychisch deutlich besser als vor der Erfahrung.
I'm lighter and less anxious. I don't ruminate like I used to.

My mental health has improved a lot since I stopped trying to save everyone. I'd been running on empty for years, and I didn't realise how exhausted and depressed I was. I thought feeling tired and joyless was normal. Since the experience, I've learned to take care of myself, and that has made a huge difference. I'm less anxious, I sleep better, and I have energy for things I enjoy. I understand myself much better: I see that my need to take care of everyone came from a childhood where I had to be the adult. That understanding has given me a lot of compassion for myself. I also feel more love for my family, oddly, now that I'm not trying to fix them. I can just be with them. My relationship with my sister is better than it's been in years.
Ich bin ruhiger und ausgeglichener. Mir geht es gut.

My anxiety has improved a lot. I used to have panic attacks regularly and I almost dropped out of uni because of them. Now they're rare. I feel more confident in myself, and I've realised that I'm more than my grades. I'm more open to enjoying my student life, I've joined a few societies and made some good friends.
More balanced, less burnt out

Meine psychische Gesundheit war vor der Erfahrung in einem sehr schlechten Zustand. Ich war erschöpft, deprimiert und hatte das Gefühl, dass mein Leben nur noch aus Pflege und Verzweiflung besteht. Die Erfahrung hat mir geholfen, wieder Liebe und Dankbarkeit zu spüren. Ich bin dankbar für die vielen Jahre, die ich mit meinem Mann hatte, und für die Momente, in denen er mich noch erkennt und anlächelt. Ich bin auch dankbar für meine Tochter, die mich so unterstützt. Ich habe gelernt, auch an mich zu denken, und gehe jetzt regelmäßig schwimmen und treffe meine Freundinnen. Das gibt mir Kraft. Die Trauer ist noch da, aber sie ist nicht mehr so erdrückend. Ich habe wieder Freude am Leben, auch wenn es ein anderes Leben ist, als ich es mir vorgestellt hatte.
I feel a bit numb, honestly. Not unhappy, just kind of detached from everything. The experience was amazing but since then nothing really moves me.

I'm much less anxious and more present. I enjoy my life more and I notice the little things. I feel calmer and happier in general. Yoga has helped me keep this up, and I feel healthier in my body too.
Ich bin entspannter und habe weniger Druck. Das hat meine Stimmung verbessert.

My mental health has improved a lot since the experience. I had been showing signs of PTSD from my work in the ED, things like nightmares, irritability, and a kind of numbness, though I didn't recognise it at the time. I thought it was just part of the job. The experience brought all of that to the surface, and since then I've been able to process it. My nightmares have mostly stopped. I'm less irritable and more present with my partner and my friends. I feel things again, which is both good and hard. I've also become more compassionate towards myself. I used to think I had to be tough to do my job, but now I see that being able to feel is what makes me good at it. I'm grateful for the experience and for the therapist I've been seeing, who has helped me integrate it.
More at peace, less frustrated
Ich bin weniger ängstlich in Beziehungen und fühle mich sicherer. Ich verstehe besser, woher meine Verlustängste kommen, und kann sie besser einordnen.
It felt life-changing for about a month. I was so happy and full of energy. Then work and life took over and it was gone. I wish I could get that feeling back.

My mental health has improved quite a lot. I was depressed for many years after my accident, and I'd mostly given up on feeling good again. The experience showed me that I could feel peace and even joy in this body. I'm less angry and less depressed now. I've made peace with my body, which I never thought would happen. I also feel more connected to other people, especially other disabled people who understand what I've been through. I've become more open to life, I travel again, I go to concerts, I've even tried adaptive sports. I appreciate what I can do instead of only mourning what I can't. It's been a long journey and the experience was just one part of it, but an important one.
Mir geht es psychisch besser, ich bin weniger erschöpft
I'm less angry and more emotionally stable. I understand myself better, and my relationship with my son has improved.
I'm more relaxed and accepting, which makes me happier

Meine soziale Angst ist deutlich besser geworden, und das hat sich auf mein ganzes Leben ausgewirkt. Ich bin weniger einsam, weil ich mich traue, auf Menschen zuzugehen. Ich habe neue Freunde gefunden und fühle mich in meinem Team bei der Arbeit wohler. Ich bin auch selbstbewusster geworden, weil ich gemerkt habe, dass ich mehr kann, als ich dachte. Vor allem aber fühle ich mich mehr verbunden mit anderen Menschen. Ich habe nicht mehr das Gefühl, anders oder falsch zu sein. Das hat meine Stimmung und mein Selbstwertgefühl sehr verbessert. Ich bin offener für neue Erfahrungen und habe mehr Freude am Leben.
Happier and lighter. I don't take myself so seriously.
No impact on my mental health that I'm aware of. I enjoyed it but that's it.
Ich bin weniger ängstlich und kann mein Leben mehr genießen. Ich mache mir weniger Sorgen um die Zukunft und bin dankbarer für das, was ich jetzt habe.
